cards.rules_text: Invoke Oath 2 + Sigil 2 (2 Rounds). Once per round, cancel Displace or Steal Charge against your units. Your Sanctuary Field gains Hidden Line.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Friendly Stone Tests gain +1; after you win one, Displace the loser.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Once per round, copy one friendly Name, Site, or Relic text until end of turn.
Invoke for 2 rounds. When you win a Wind Test, Steal Charge and raise opponent's Audit Heat +1.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Enemy Names gain +1 Swap Risk while this is active.
Invoke for 2 rounds. The first friendly Wind or Eye Test each round gains +2.
Invoke for 2 rounds. After you win an Oath or Eye Test, place Bind on a Downed unit without extra cost.
Invoke for 2 rounds. When an enemy Falls Silent, you may draw 1.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Once per round, deal 1 Wound to a unit that crossed your Line.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Friendly Edicts cost 1 less this round and next.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Once per round, win ties on Oath or Eye Tests.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Once per round, move one friendly unit between Fields without triggering Geas.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Enemies crossing your Line lose 1 Oath.
Invoke for 2 rounds. Once each turn, clear Silence from a friendly unit or Name.
Invoke for 2 rounds. After a friendly Displace, you may move the same unit into another friendly Field.
